title: Add Oracle Mystique to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Oracle Mystique](https://oracle-mystique.up.railway.app) to chat
- Oracle Mystique : AI-powered tarot reading with 3 cards (Past/Present/Future), AI-generated illustrations, interpretation in English. Full BYOP OAuth2 implementation.

Fixes #15151

gist.headline: Three cards, one oracle
gist.blurb: Oracle Mystique has joined the garden: a three-card tarot reader for past, present, and future, with illustrated readings in English. Bring your own OAuth2 petals; the oracle supplies the atmosphere.
gist.summary: Added Oracle Mystique to the app catalog: an AI-powered English tarot reader that draws and illustrates Past, Present, and Future cards with full BYOP OAuth2 support.
gist.impact: Users can now discover and launch a three-card AI tarot experience with generated card art and OAuth2-based bring-your-own-provider access.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Oracle Mystique as a cozy tarot table in a moonlit-but-warm garden nook: three glowing pixel tarot cards labeled Past, Present, and Future, surrounded by flowers and code-vines. Polli wears a tiny wizard hat and gently turns over a card while a retro CRT terminal displays a friendly OAuth2 key symbol, making the app's illustrated divination and BYOP login visible without feeling technical.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny wizard hat as she reveals three glowing tarot cards on a warm garden table labeled in simple pixel font: “PAST”, “PRESENT”, “FUTURE”; a small retro CRT beside her shows a friendly key icon, with code-plants, flowers, and prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow among lavender, mint, peach, and warm cream. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and mystical rather than dark.
